title: 29th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/29/1/2025).

Question from Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas to the Minister of Construction, Housing and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: work on developing N. Velidhoo harbour has been stalled for some time; when will it be completed so residents and visitors can use a modern harbour?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Construction, Housing and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: the repair of B. Dhonfanu harbour's outer breakwater and channel markers is not going ahead as agreed with residents, which worries them given the safety of people and property; when will the work start and finish?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for membership of the Maldives Broadcasting Commission, under Article 6(b) of the Broadcasting Act (Law No. 16/2010), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of a government bill, sponsored by Hoarafushi MP Ali Moosa, to amend the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010).
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Maldives Civil Aviation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé Central MP Abdulla Shazmee.
Report of the Finance Committee on the President's nominee for Deputy Governor of the Maldives Monetary Authority, under Article 6(3) of the MMA Act (Law No. 6/81).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the housing minister on two stalled island harbours, sent a Broadcasting Commission nominee to committee, introduced a Decentralisation Act amendment, continued the Civil Aviation Bill, and took up the Finance Committee's report on the MMA Deputy Governor nominee.
